description: Header file defining structures, constants, and function prototypes for STM32F10x USART peripheral firmware library.

methods.name: USART_DeInit
methods.description: De-initializes the USART peripheral registers to their default reset values.

methods.name: USART_Init
methods.description: Initializes the USART peripheral with specified parameters.

methods.name: USART_StructInit
methods.description: Fills each USART_InitTypeDef member with its default value.

methods.name: USART_ClockInit
methods.description: Initializes the USART clock according to the specified parameters.

methods.name: USART_ClockStructInit
methods.description: Fills each USART_ClockInitTypeDef member with its default value.

methods.name: USART_Cmd
methods.description: Enables or disables the specified USART peripheral.

methods.name: USART_ITConfig
methods.description: Configures the USART interrupt sources.

methods.name: USART_DMACmd
methods.description: Enables or disables the USART DMA requests.

methods.name: USART_SetAddress
methods.description: Sets the address of the USART in multi-processor communication.

methods.name: USART_WakeUpConfig
methods.description: Configures the USART wake-up method.

methods.name: USART_ReceiverWakeUpCmd
methods.description: Enables or disables the USART receiver wake-up from mute mode.

methods.name: USART_LINBreakDetectLengthConfig
methods.description: Configures the length of the LIN break detection.

methods.name: USART_LINCmd
methods.description: Enables or disables the LIN mode.

methods.name: USART_SendData
methods.description: Transmits data through the USART.

methods.name: USART_ReceiveData
methods.description: Receives data from the USART.

methods.name: USART_SendBreak
methods.description: Transmits a break character.

methods.name: USART_SetGuardTime
methods.description: Sets the guard time value.

methods.name: USART_SetPrescaler
methods.description: Sets the prescaler value.

methods.name: USART_SmartCardCmd
methods.description: Enables or disables the SmartCard mode.

methods.name: USART_SmartCardNACKCmd
methods.description: Enables or disables the NACK transmission in SmartCard mode.

methods.name: USART_HalfDuplexCmd
methods.description: Enables or disables the Half-Duplex mode.

methods.name: USART_OverSampling8Cmd
methods.description: Enables or disables the OverSampling by 8 mode.

methods.name: USART_OneBitMethodCmd
methods.description: Enables or disables the One Bit method.

methods.name: USART_IrDAConfig
methods.description: Configures the IrDA mode.

methods.name: USART_IrDACmd
methods.description: Enables or disables the IrDA mode.

methods.name: USART_GetFlagStatus
methods.description: Checks whether the specified USART flag is set or not.

methods.name: USART_ClearFlag
methods.description: Clears the USART's pending flags.

methods.name: USART_GetITStatus
methods.description: Checks whether the specified USART interrupt has occurred.

methods.name: USART_ClearITPendingBit
methods.description: Clears the USART's interrupt pending bits.
